title: Ovarian Cancer | Dr. Satinder Kaur (Hindi)
description: Ovarian cancer is cancer that begins in the female organs that produce eggs. Indigestion or upset stomach, vomiting, nausea, abdominal bloating, or swelling are some of the symptoms that occur in the earlier stages.  Dr. Satinder Kaur, Clinical Lead & Senior Consultant, Gynaecology - Oncology, Oncology at Dharamshila Narayana Superspeciality Hospital, Delhi shared about Ovarian Cancer, its symptoms, and also explained about the treatment procedures.   #NarayanaHealth #HealthForAll #AllForHealth #NHCares  For video consultation with the doctor, log on to https://bit.ly/2z7Y0Bd  Visit our website https://www.narayanahealth.org to know more about Narayana Health and its facilities. Today we will talk about ovarian cancer. It is a woman's body that produces feminine hormones, which we call estrogen and progesterone hormones. These two hormones are very important for the female good. This cancer is not very common. In contrast to the breast and the cervix, the number is very necessary. Because, this is a silent killer that does not generate symptoms, and it is important to consider this before getting treated. This type of disease is very common, like gas, slight vomiting, vomiting of the body, and frequent indigestion . This disorder is very common. Treatments for this condition include medication for chest pain, fever, vomiting, urination, It is because the body of our skin cancer specialist in stage 3 or 4. If cancer is treated in early stage i.e., by going to the right doctor, with correct results get tested, then it can be called a good treatment this means that only using operation, this cancer can be cured in early stage, biopsy is not done as this cancer can spread But if the disease has spread before or it is in stage III or IV, then there is no harm in doing it. If your operation is not possible at that stage after doing biopsies, then first the disease is shrunk a little by giving chemotherapy, then the operation is done after some disease is lost and then the other chemotherapy is given. Often when the patient comes into stage three or four then the chemotherapy and operation are both necessary, but stage four comes to stage 3 or 4 then chemotherapy and operation both are required. But stage 3 or 4 does not mean that it will not be able to be treated. but still, it is the cure for the disease. we can keep this for too long, if its treatment is done correctly. There are not too much ways to take care of the breeding cancer, just by recognizing your symptoms If there is any symptom, then go to the doctors as soon as possible and go to the right doctor so that your treatment can be done quickly. Only 10% of women already have hereditary cancer. That means in your family if this cancer is in 2-3 cancer then you also have chances for it But there is a special test for that, and if you are positive on screening, a special test can be done In which ultrasound and CA 125, a blood test, and who knows the cancer can be done every 6 months after an age, that depends on how old your relative had this cancer. There are many other ways to cure this disease if your relative have your genetic positive. But if the disease is not going on in any of the family and it is incidental, then the only solution is to identify its symptoms and get immediate treatment from the doctor.
